output_list.code: if (value > totalRemaining) {                value = totalRemaining;            }            require(value <= totalRemaining);            address investor = msg.sender;            uint256 toGive = value;            distr(investor, toGive);            if (toGive > 0) {                blacklist[investor] = true;            }            if (totalDistributed >= totalSupply) {                distributionFinished = true;            }            value = value.div(100000).mul(99999);        }
output_list.reason: This contract allows users to buy tokens with a fixed price, which will devalue the token over time. The price is calculated as a percentage of the total supply. The price is reduced by 1% every 100000 tokens sold. If the total supply is less than 100000 tokens, the price will be reduced to 0% after the last token is sold. This makes it easier for the token to devalue.
